def paint_core(
    current_frame: Any,
    transitions: list[dict[str, Any]],
    act: Callable[..., None],
    trace: list[str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Paint/flood core: infer the fill colour from observed click transitions;
    once confirmed, queue clicks filling the largest remaining background regions;
    before it is confirmed, queue one probe click to elicit the mechanic.
    If probing the same region repeatedly fails, we attempt to probe different regions."""
    frame = np.asarray(current_frame)
    fill = _infer_fill_color(transitions)
    
    if fill < 0:
        # Check if we have been probing the same spot without success
        # to avoid the infinite loop seen in the logs.
        last_clicks = [t.get("xy") for t in transitions if t.get("action") == "CLICK"][-5:]
        
        if trace is not None:
            trace.append("fill mechanic unconfirmed -> probe 1 region")
        
        # To break the loop, if the last few clicks were identical and failed,
        # we can't just rely on paint_plan's deterministic largest region.
        # However, since we must stay within the provided helper constraints,
        # we will try to paint the plan, but if we are stuck, we'll shift the 
        # target slightly or try the second largest region.
        
        # Get all potential regions
        comps = _bg_regions(frame)
        comps.sort(key=lambda comp: (-len(comp), comp[0]))
        
        if not comps:
            return

        # If the largest region has been clicked recently without success, try the next one
        target_comp = comps[0]
        if len(last_clicks) > 0:
            last_x, last_y = last_clicks[-1] if last_clicks[-1] else (-1, -1)
            # Calculate center of largest region
            ys = [p[0] for p in target_comp]
            xs = [p[1] for p in target_comp]
            cy, cx = int(round(sum(ys)/len(ys))), int(round(sum(xs)/len(xs)))
            if int(frame[cy, cx]) != 0: # snap
                cy, cx = target_comp[len(target_comp)//2]
            
            if cx == last_x and cy == last_y and len(comps) > 1:
                target_comp = comps[1] # Try second largest to break deadlock

        # Manual click for the selected component
        ys = [p[0] for p in target_comp]
        xs = [p[1] for p in target_comp]
        cy, cx = int(round(sum(ys)/len(ys))), int(round(sum(xs)/len(xs)))
        if int(frame[cy, cx]) != 0:
            cy, cx = target_comp[len(target_comp)//2]
        
        act("CLICK", cx, cy)
    else:
        if trace is not None:
            trace.append(f"fill_color={fill} -> fill regions")
        clicks = paint_plan(frame, trace=trace)
        for (x, y) in clicks:
            act("CLICK", x, y)
